summary: End-to-end validation of the NOVIQ-matching homepage redesign + backend APIs. Hero centered, phone dynamic island present, Smart Home header + subtitle visible, room tiles rendered in a confirmed 2-column CSS grid (grid-template-columns: 191.8px 191.8px), LIVE FLOORPLAN badge visible, cool-white light overlays on NoLights.png, All On/All Off/individual toggles all work for all 8 rooms (living, kitchen, bedroom, office, garage, hallway, bath1, bath2), partners section renders all 4 brands, and capability cards show all 9 expanded sub-feature labels + descriptions. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests pass, /api/quotations = 200, /api/shop/products = 200, /api/admin/login = 200.
critical_code_review_comments: HomePage.jsx is ~727 lines. Still acceptable but could be split: extract ImageFloorplan + RoomTile + ScrollingTicker into /components/home/ for maintainability.
ImageFloorplan maps over roomOverlays 3 times (spill/core/bulb). Consider a single per-room <RoomLight> sub-component to reduce DOM churn and keep JSX concise.

Demo auto-animation (useInView with animTimers ref) is correctly cleaned up, but the hard-coded 3s on-then-off sequence repeats only once (once:true) — if users scroll past quickly some rooms may appear stuck on. Not blocking; the All Off button recovers.

Backend test file hardcodes REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL default to '' leading to invalid-URL error when env not passed. Consider loading from /app/frontend/.env explicitly via python-dotenv to remove the need to export it manually.
seed_data_creation: Pytest creates TEST_-prefixed customers; the test@inhaus.co.in customer is (re)seeded on each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: HomePage NOVIQ-match layout: hero centered, phone dynamic island (black pill + orange dot) at top of controller, Smart Home header + 'Tap to illuminate each space' subtitle, 8 room tiles in 2-col grid (IDs: living, kitchen, bedroom, office, garage, hallway, bath1, bath2). data-testid selectors: hero-section, hero-title, hero-cta-primary/secondary, scrolling-ticker, smart-demo-section, all-on-btn, all-off-btn, voice-cmd-btn, room-tile-{id}, room-toggle-{id}, light-overlay-{id}, partners-section, capabilities-section, capability-card-{0..2}, cta-section. Demo auto-animates once when section enters viewport so tests should wait ~5s or click all-off-btn before asserting. NOTE: when running pytest, must pass REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var explicitly (backend/.env doesn't have it).
